patthana17.15:1.1: kusalaṃ maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na maggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana17.15:2.1: kusalaṃ maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na maggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.15:3.1: kusalaṃ maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na maggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
